### God Pursues Us When We've Sinned
Author: Jim Liebelt
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/god-pursues-us-when-weve-sinned-homeword-april-24.html
Passage: 2 Samuel 11:27
Points:
- David orchestrated Uriah's death, married Bathsheba, and carried on without outward remorse.
- People frequently rationalize and overlook their own sins just as easily as David did.
- God loved David too much to let his hidden sin remain buried and forgotten.
- Confrontation by God gives believers the opportunity to face truth, repent, and receive cleansing.

### Confession and Relief
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-december-20-2024.html
Passage: 2 Samuel 11:27
Points:
- Sin deceives people into thinking their concealed actions have gone unnoticed.
- While David believed his cover-up succeeded, the Lord saw his wicked conduct clearly.
- God's dispatching of Nathan to confront David was an expression of divine grace.
- Fearing human opinion often keeps believers trapped in secrecy and guilt.
- Bringing hidden sins into the open before God yields the lasting relief of His forgiveness.
